**v1.8.0: the bot throws away the blade and trap copies it can't cast again.**
- **Blades and traps.** With `reboost` off (the default), the bot casts each blade and trap once a battle, plus once sharpened (a trap made potent) while a Sharpen (a Potent) is in your hand or still in the worn deck. Its other copies in your hand can't go, so the bot now right-clicks them away and the hand draws cards it can use. Before, they stayed in your hand till a Reshuffle (v1.7.0's "Worth knowing"). The weakest copy goes first, up to 3 of one blade or trap a round, not counted in `discardmax`. These discards never take a treasure or item card's copy, nor a card set to Never discard whose picture the bot found (a blade left to v1.7.0's rule - both its casts went - goes as it did).
- **Only when it's sure.** The bot does it only once the vision helper reads the game's hand and the game's card boxes have lined up with the screen's 3 looks in a row at your window size (the check memclicks waits for, with memclicks on or off - debug.log "Memory card boxes ... they line up, 3 looks in a row"), with one game window open. Only as a Hitter or with the party off, and not in dual mode. With `reboost` on, nothing changes. A blade or trap whose copies it can't be sure of is left to v1.7.0's rule, and one whose right-click didn't take isn't tried again that battle.
- **The setting.** `discardspent`, on: Settings > HOW IT PLAYS ITS CARDS, "...and blade and trap copies it can't cast again (untried)" under "Discard cards it never plays" (that one has to be on too). A deck can have its own (the Cards tab). Off: the copies are held, as in v1.7.0. It's on for updated installs too.
- **The simulator follows it.** "Can this deck beat it" and the zone deck (`deckzone`) pick decks with several copies of a blade or trap again, and the planner's tries throw the copies away too (a hitter teammate's as well). As a Blader or Healer with the party on, or in dual mode, the bot keeps them, and the simulator is told so. Where the bot can't read the game's hand, or the boxes haven't lined up yet, it keeps them but the simulator still throws them away. Measured on the same dice (2000 battles each), copies held -> thrown away:
  - 8 Storm Lord + 6 Stormblade + 6 Storm Trap against a 6000-health boss: 56.4% won -> 93.1% (it didn't finish the battle 43.6% of the time, now 6.9%). v1.7.0's notes said 59.5% and 91.8%; those came from a run that wasn't kept.
  - The same deck with a Reshuffle: 70.8% -> 96.7%.
  - 4 Storm Lord, 4 Tempest, 3 Stormblade, 3 Thunderblade, 4 Storm Trap and 2 Feint against 3 mobs: 17.7% -> 35.0%.
  - A deck with at most one card per blade or trap slot (Stormblade and Thunderblade share the storm blade's): "Can this deck beat it" and the zone deck exactly as before. `reboost` on still wins more in most fights (96.9% for the first deck), because it casts each blade again after every hit.
- **Learned hits in no slot** (a treasure Sandstorm, say) are no longer held back in a round that discarded something: the bot reads the hand again after the round's discards. Before, any discard kept them back for that round.
- **Fleeing.** With the copies it can't cast gone, a long battle that runs the deck out empties the hand sooner, so the bot flees "no cards left" earlier instead of passing with those copies in hand.
- **debug.log** has a line for each copy, like "Discarded Stormblade - storm/blade: 3 of the deck's copies in hand, 1 cast left this battle ...", and once a battle how many Sharpen and Potent cards the worn deck holds. The Dashboard's Discarded count goes up by as much. A round with discards takes a few seconds longer.
- **Mixed versions are fine.** An older AutoFarmer with this helper: the simulator holds the copies, as that bot does. This AutoFarmer with an older helper: the helper can't count the worn deck's Sharpen and Potent cards (it has no `/deckkinds`), so only one in your hand keeps a copy back, and its simulator plays as before.
- **Not tried in the game yet.** AutoFarmer\LIVE_CHECKS.txt step 3.11 says what to look for and send. memclicks is now step 3.12, still last. If a wrong card goes, switch `discardspent` off.
- **Updating:** the updater offers this to every install, including ones set up from the v0.7.0 or v0.7.1 zips. Your settings, learned cards and routes are kept. A copy run from the code: git pull.
